name: web-analytics-dashboard
tagline: A web analytics board with traffic charts, live visitors and top-page tables.
summary: A responsive dashboard grid with a twelve-month visitor area chart, a live visitor count split by device, ranked tables for pages, countries and referrers, share bars, and Core Web Vitals.
appearance: Laid out as a four column grid of bordered cards: a wide area chart with a large total, a live visitors card with three device share bars, then tables for top pages, countries and referrers, small share-bar cards, and a three-up Core Web Vitals row.
behaviour: Mostly static: hovering chart points raises a tooltip, the live visitor dot pulses continuously, and View All links sit over faded table edges. Figures never update on their own.
demo_content: Data for northwind.dev across twelve months, with sample pages, countries, referrer hosts and vitals
search_phrases: analytics overview page for a website
use_when: A product or marketing site needs a ready-made overview of traffic, sources and page performance.
avoid_when: Live or real data, since every figure and table row is sample data baked into the file.
customise: Every figure, table row and chart point is a constant in the file, so real data means editing or lifting the subcomponents. Colours follow the chart theme variables.
weight_why: A Recharts area chart plus several tables; mostly static markup with one pulsing dot.

a11y.note: Tables carry screen-reader captions and the chart is keyboard reachable, but the pulsing live dot ignores reduced-motion.

issues: No screenshot was recorded, so the actual rendering is unverified.
The live visitor count is a fixed 94 and never updates.
All chart and table data is hardcoded sample content.
polish_why: A standard analytics card grid from shared primitives; no frames exist to judge the real rendering.
title: Web Analytics Dashboard
